name: Will trading zero-margin order forced into public expired settlement
summary: The WILL short-trading contract's placeSellOrder accepts margin 0, giving closeTime = block.timestamp, and sells contract-held (staked) WILL for USDT. Anyone can then call updateExpiredOrders, which books 1.8x the shorted USDT for buy-back, and settleExpiredPositions, which spends that contract USDT on WILL at the live pool price with a caller-chosen minTokensToReceive. The attacker opened an instantly expired order, pumped WILL, and made the contract buy back at the inflated price before dumping.
notes: setPairAddress replaced pairAddress (slot 11), a codeless address set at block 39918546 on which getReserves() and therefore placeSellOrder revert, with the canonical PancakeSwap WILL/USDT pair created at block 39946063. The first sell order follows at block 39946751; this change made the zero-margin order and expired-settlement path operational.

Attacker contract net USDT gain across both campaign transactions (source-1 and source-7). The victim's gross depletion is 2,722,729.9 WILL (staked user tokens) against a 13,854.51 USDT net gain (71,306.38 USDT attacker order deposit plus 70,899.62 USDT sale proceeds minus 128,351.49 USDT settlement spend); the dumped WILL crashed the pair price (0.0878 to 0.0077 USDT per WILL), so a pre-exploit spot valuation of that WILL is not realisable and the attacker's realised USDT gain is used instead. The PoC header's ~52,777 USD profit is not reproduced by the receipts.
